summary: This configuration file sets up ESLint rules for JavaScript and JSX files in the frontend of a React application, including React Hooks and React Refresh.
evidence: Imports necessary ESLint plugins and configurations for JavaScript and JSX files.
Configures ESLint to use the latest ECMAScript version and JSX features.
Enables React Hooks and React Refresh plugins.
Sets up rules to enforce no unused variables, with a specific pattern for variable names.
Enforces that only components are exported using React Refresh.
